# OM Electrotech

OM Electrotech is a Media Production company. Om Electrotech is a retailer of protection relays, ABB auxiliary signaling and tripping relays, and modular relays. OM Electrotech employs 8 people (+14.3% YoY, +1 person). Headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

## About

Om Electrotech is a pioneer name known for wholeselling and supplying a broad consignment of products comprising Feeder Protection Relay, Electromechanical Relays and Transmission Relays.
